title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — June 2016–2025, Chamonix (45.9231 N, 6.8700 E)
claims: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive for the grid cell at 45.9231 N, 6.8700 E, elevation 1,035 m, over the 300 June days from 2016 to 2025: mean daily maximum 20.9 °C and mean daily minimum 10.7 °C.
The same query gives mean precipitation of 4.7 mm per day; 171 of the 300 June days (57%) had at least 1 mm.
These are reanalysis statistics for the Chamonix valley grid cell, not official race data and not measurements from the 42 km course or the Posettes ridge.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接查询 Open-Meteo archive API，取 2016–2025 年 6 月共 300 天，按 daily time 过滤 06 月后计算均值；坐标与海拔采用 Chamonix 镇中心。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 300 个 6 月日值；temperature_2m_max 均值 20.9，temperature_2m_min 均值 10.7。
precipitation_sum 均值 4.7 mm/day；≥1 mm 的日数 171/300 = 57%。
Chamonix 镇中心 1,035 m；赛道最高点更高，本页明确不把镇中心数据当成赛道全程数据。
